refund.guarantee: 30-day satisfaction guarantee: if you're not satisfied within 30 days after go-live, we refund the setup fee for the AI line and switch the line off. On the bundle, only the AI line's part of the setup fee is refunded and the website stays yours. Monthly fees for the period used are not refunded.
